charts.title: Speed-vs-fidelity frontier + same-harness runtime — every method on the sepsis core
charts.caption: Every simulation method on the sepsis core placed on one speed-vs-fidelity frontier (left) plus the same-harness runtime (right, 2 h severity-3). Exact engines (BioGears/Tellurium/COPASI/Rust) cluster at ~1x speed and <1% error; proto_valve and the event-driven hybrid sit just above 1x inside the exact-fidelity band (~1e-3, 233-236 s vs 284 s); the mean-hemodynamics reduction (~5.6e7x) and the PyTorch surrogate (~4e4x, inadmissible) trade orders of magnitude of speed for fidelity. The hybrid's blood-pathogen transient is shown as a faint secondary point. Runtimes are same-engine/same-Composite-harness for the 3 roadrunner methods; the accelerated tiers (annotated) are committed numbers at their own horizons.

charts.title: Per-observable fidelity matrix + trajectory detail — where the methods agree and diverge
charts.caption: Per-observable fidelity matrix (left): max relative error vs the exact reference for COPASI (vs Tellurium), proto_valve and the event-driven hybrid (both vs the full model). COPASI agrees everywhere (<5e-4); proto_valve and the hybrid are identical on every observable (~6% on CO/SVR from the dropped per-beat layer) EXCEPT blood pathogen, which is exact for proto_valve (events in SBML) but a ~20% transient for the hybrid (events in the composition layer, tick-quantized infection start). Right: the blood-pathogen infection curve (all methods track) and the pulsatile MAP detail.
